        The 2026 Winter Olympics closing ceremony took place on 22 February 2026. It started at 20:30 CET (19:30 UTC) and concluded at 23:00. Entitled "Beauty in Action", the ceremony was held at the Verona Arena in Verona, Italy. As mandated by the Olympic Charter, the proceedings combine the protocol-related and cultural segments. [1]
